title: upgrade-attn-flashattnv2-rope-fused-kv-batching-scheduling: FlashAttentionV2 + fused rotary/rope + KV-batching scheduler
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: reduce per-token latency and increase throughput for long-context workloads by upgrading to the latest FlashAttentionV2 kernels, fusing rotary/rope math into the attention kernel, and adding a KV-cache-aware batching scheduler. This change consolidates several performance efforts into one deliverable: (1) integrate upstream FlashAttentionV2 with our plugin interface and expose a fused-op path for rotary/rope encodings, (2) add a fused QKV+split kernel for improved memory locality on A100/H100, (3) implement a KV-aware continuous batching scheduler that groups requests by KV-cache compatibility to avoid repeated KV re-computation and improve GPU utilization, and (4) provide safe fallbacks for quantized and non-fused models. Summary of changes: integrated flashattnv2 submodule, added fused_rotary and fused_qkv kernels, updated kernel selection logic in src/runtime/scheduler to prefer fused paths when model profiles and device capabilities match, introduced kv_batching policy that annotates request metadata for prefix-compatibility, added perf canary and benchmark harness entries, extended unit and integration tests. Checklist: - [x] FlashAttentionV2 upstream integration and wrapper - [x] Fused rotary/rope implementation and correctness tests - [x] Fused QKV kernel and memory layout refactor - [x] KV-batching scheduler implementation and canary - [x] Performance benchmarks and artifacts uploaded to Linear ticket - [x] CI green and e2e perf canary stable - [x] Rollout plan with staged flag and fallback. Rollout: feature-flagged rollout starting with internal canary -> perf-canary pool -> 10% production -> 50% -> global. Observability: added per-kernel counters, fallback counters, and a dashboard tile summary. Risks and mitigations: fused kernels are guarded by a capability check (compute capability >= 8.0) and a runtime flag; quantized int8 pathways default to non-fused until tested. Related tickets: ENG-3421, ENG-3488, PM-102. Notes: description includes microbenchmarks below and a short summary of review feedback and CI reruns.

benchmarks_summary: LLaMA-2-13B, A100-40GB, seq=2048: p50 latency -18% (from 320ms to 262ms), throughput +32%
MPT-7B, H100-80GB, seq=1024: p50 latency -22%, throughput +40%
OPT-6.7B, A100-40GB, mixed-precision: throughput +28% with fused_qkv path
Short-context (seq=128) workloads: negligible regression (~1-2%) when fused path chosen due to kernel startup; scheduler prefers non-fused for tiny batches
